recovery.what: The lane's first `git push` ran .githooks/pre-push -> scripts/ci_check.sh, and the suite's throwaway-repository fixtures committed onto this lane's own branch instead of their tmp_path: git exports GIT_DIR into every hook environment, GIT_DIR outranks cwd and -C, and core/git_safety/git.py::run_git forwards os.environ wholesale. Six fixture commits (seed/initial/placeholder, author `Test <test@example.com>`, 08:35:31-08:37:32 UTC) walked refs/heads/lane-f/LANE-F-01 off 1f74766 down to a two-file tree; `git ls-files` reported 2 tracked files where there are 465.
recovery.symptom: 8 failures in tests/test_version_bump_discipline.py, all '<path> is not tracked at HEAD' - the corruption's symptom, not a real red. They pass on the restored tree.
recovery.known_defect: Not new: .githooks/pre-push already carries lane D's 2026-09-11 diagnosis and scrubs GIT_DIR and friends, naming the durable fix as run_git refusing to forward them. Lane F branched at 692f57c, where that hook was still at b9ba2be (2026-09-09), and core.hooksPath is an absolute path into the primary checkout - so the hook text that runs is the primary's working copy at push time, not the branch's. Second measured occurrence, third lane.
